title: 第一卷 第25章 乱世之中最无力的绝望第一卷 第26章 什么狗屁贵人什么狗屁律条
lines: 外面的衙役们相互递了个眼色，其中一人悄悄转身，回去叫人了。【表情】
陈渊将这一切看在眼里，却丝毫不在意，依旧大快朵颐，直到吃得油光满面、腹饱神舒，才缓缓放下筷子。【表情】
就在这时，酒馆外面的街道上，突然传来一阵凄厉的哭喊与求饶声，刺破了街道的热闹，瞬间吸引了酒馆里所有人的注意。【表情】
就连刚放下筷子的陈渊三人，也纷纷转头，疑惑地看向酒馆门外。【表情】
只见一群穿着锦服的公子哥，带领着一群手持棍棒的手下，正团团包围着一对穿着破旧麻衣的老夫妻。【表情】
其中几个执刀大汉目光狠厉，对着倒在地上的老头和老妪，毫不留情地猛敲他们的眼睛，直打得两人眼睛爆裂、鲜血直流，哀嚎不止。【表情】
还有一个少女跪在地上，不停地磕头求饶，哭得声泪俱下，额头早已磕得血肉模糊。【表情】
街道两旁围满了围观的人，一个个指指点点，脸上没有丝毫同情，
反而带着玩味的笑意，就像是在看两条老狗被欺凌，一副看好戏的模样。【表情】
“哼，见到满相籍的贵人，也敢用你的脏眼睛直瞧？”
其中一位穿着蓝色锦袍的青年冷声开口，满脸倨傲，“这是大不敬之罪！
打瞎你们的眼睛，就是给你们的惩戒！”【表情】
他对着手下厉声大吼：“打！继续打！
把这两个老东西的另一只眼睛也打瞎！让他们记住，什么人是他们得罪不起的！”
“啊……贵、贵人，我们只是路过，只是不小心看了您一眼而已，求您高抬贵手啊……”【表情】
“呜呜……饶命啊，求您饶了我们吧！”【表情】
“我们真的不是故意的，求您开恩……”【表情】
“爹！娘！呜呜……你们不要打我爹娘！
求求你们了，我给你们磕头，我给你们磕头还不行吗？”【表情】
两个老人趴在地上，一边哀嚎求饶，一边用脑袋狠狠撞地。
额头很快撞得头破血流，再加上一只眼睛被打瞎，模样凄惨至极。【表情】
他们的女儿虽穿着破旧麻布衣衫，却身段姣好，此刻衣衫被撕扯开一角，露出一片肌肤，让那几个锦服公子哥瞬间玩兴大起。【表情】
“哈哈哈哈，柳公子，这个小丫头倒是有几分姿色，不如柳公子玩玩？”
一人盯着少女，眼睛发亮，语气轻佻。【表情】
“不错不错！她父母冲撞了柳公子您，不如就让他们的女儿来赔罪，伺候柳公子尽兴？”【表情】
“哈哈哈，说得对！
虽说他们是众生籍，可柳公子您是尊贵的满相籍，乃是天地的宠儿，
他们冲撞贵人，本就该受罚，让女儿赔罪，已是便宜他们了！”【表情】
几个公子哥嬉笑着，语气中满是傲然与得意，仿佛一言就能决定他人的生死与尊严，享受着这种掌控他人命运的快感。【表情】
被称呼为柳公子的青年，乃是怀山县柳家的少爷柳公全。
他身着一袭白衣，手持折扇，看起来风度翩翩，眼底却藏着一丝淫邪。【表情】
听闻手下的话，他缓步走到少女面前，弯腰捏住她的下巴，强行将她的脑袋抬起。【表情】
映入眼帘的，是一张梨花带雨的脸蛋。
虽布满灰尘，却难掩精致的五官，稚嫩的脸庞上满是恐惧与无助，让人见了心生怜悯。【表情】
“嗯，不错，倒是个可人的小东西。”
柳公全双眼泛起绿光，一股奇异的天赋之力在他周身流转，化作浓浓的淫邪之意，
“行，你们围成一个圈，好好看着，本公子如何惩罚一个敢冲撞贵族的贱人！”【表情】
“别以为入了众生籍，就真的是人了！
在本公子这满相籍贵人面前，你们这些众生籍的人族，不过是些供人玩乐的贱人罢了！”
柳公全傲然开口，一边说着，一边伸手扯自己的裤腰带。【表情】
霎时间，周围响起一阵哄笑声与欢呼声，围观的人非但没有一个站出来阻止，反而露出更加期待的神色，眼神里满是龌龊。【表情】
毕竟，在这大相帝国，众生籍在贵族面前，终究是低人一等，
即便名义上是人，也依旧被视作贱人！
任人欺凌，无人问津。【表情】
衣服被撕开的声音、柳公全嚣张的淫笑、少女绝望的哭喊、老夫妻撕心裂肺的求饶，交织在一起，勾勒出这大相帝国底层最肮脏、最残酷的一面。【表情】
content_en:
The government officials outside glanced at each other, and one of them quietly turned around and went back to call someone. 【expression】
Chen Yuan saw all this, but didn't care at all. He continued to eat happily. He slowly put down his chopsticks until his face was shiny and his stomach was full. 【expression】
At this moment, a burst of shrill cries and begging for mercy suddenly came from the street outside the tavern, piercing the bustle of the street and instantly attracted the attention of everyone in the tavern. 【expression】
Even Chen Yuan and the other three who had just put down their chopsticks turned their heads and looked out the door of the tavern in confusion. 【expression】
I saw a group of young men in brocade uniforms, leading a group of men holding sticks, surrounding an old couple in shabby linen clothes. 【expression】
Several of the big men with swords looked fiercely at the old man and old woman who fell on the ground, and struck their eyes mercilessly until their eyes burst, blood flowed, and they screamed. 【expression】
There was another girl kneeling on the ground, kowtowing and begging for mercy, crying so hard that her forehead was bloody and bloody. 【expression】
The streets were lined with onlookers, all pointing and showing no sympathy on their faces.
Instead, he had a playful smile, as if he was watching two old dogs being bullied, as if he was watching a good show. 【expression】
"Huh, how dare you look at a noble person with your dirty eyes when you see him?"
One of the young men in a blue brocade robe said coldly, with a face full of arrogance, "This is a crime of great disrespect!
Blinding your eyes is a punishment for you! "[expression]
He yelled at his men: "Fight! Keep fighting!"
Blind these two old guys in the other eye too! Let them remember who they cannot afford to offend! "
"Ah... Noble, noble, we were just passing by and I just glanced at you accidentally. Please show me your noble hand..." [Expression]
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu.. Please spare us, please spare us!" [Expression]
"We really didn't mean it, please have mercy..." [Expression]
"Dad! Mom! Ouch... don't hit my parents!"
Please, I kowtow to you. Isn’t it okay for me to kowtow to you? "[expression]
The two old men lay on the ground, whining and begging for mercy while banging their heads on the ground.
His forehead was quickly bruised and bloody, and one eye was blinded, making him look extremely miserable. 【expression】
Although their daughter was wearing shabby linen clothes, she had a good figure. At this moment, a corner of her clothes was torn open, exposing a piece of skin, which made the young men in brocade clothes instantly become very amused. 【expression】
"Hahahaha, Mr. Liu, this little girl is quite pretty. How about playing with Mr. Liu?"
One person stared at the girl with bright eyes and a frivolous tone. 【expression】
"Yes, yes! Her parents have offended Mr. Liu, why not let their daughter make amends and serve Mr. Liu to their fullest pleasure?" [Expression]
"Hahaha, you're right!
Although they are all sentient beings, Mr. Liu, you are the noble Manxiang Ji and the darling of heaven and earth.
They had offended the nobles and deserved to be punished, so asking their daughter to apologize would have given them an advantage! "[expression]
The young masters laughed and laughed, their voices full of pride and pride, as if they could decide the life, death and dignity of others with just one word, enjoying the pleasure of controlling other people's destiny. 【expression】
The young man called Young Master Liu is Liu Gongquan, the young master of the Liu family in Huaishan County.
He was dressed in white and holding a folding fan. He looked elegant, but there was a hint of lust in his eyes. 【expression】
After hearing what his men said, he slowly walked up to the girl, bent down and pinched her chin, and forced her head up. 【expression】
What caught his eye was a face full of pear blossoms and rain.
Although covered with dust, the delicate facial features cannot be concealed, and the childish face is full of fear and helplessness, which makes people feel pity when they see it. 【expression】
"Well, not bad, he's quite a cute little thing."
Liu Gongquan's eyes glowed green, and a strange innate power circulated around him, turning into a strong lust for evil.
"Okay, you all gather in a circle and watch carefully how I will punish a bitch who dares to rush into a noble!" [Expression]
“Don’t think that once you become a living being, you are truly a human being!
In front of this noble man, you, all human beings, are nothing more than bitches for fun! "
Liu Gongquan spoke proudly, and while speaking, he stretched out his hand to pull his waistband. 【expression】
Suddenly, there was a burst of laughter and cheers all around. Not only did not one of the onlookers stand up to stop him, but they looked even more expectant, with dirty eyes in their eyes. 【expression】
After all, in this Prime Minister's Empire, all living beings are inferior to the nobles after all.
Even though he is a human being in name, he is still regarded as a bitch!
Let others bully you, and no one cares about you. 【expression】
The sound of clothes being torn apart, Liu Gongquan's arrogant lewd laughter, the girl's desperate cry, and the old couple's heart-wrenching pleas for mercy, all intertwined to outline the dirtiest and cruelest side of the bottom of the Daxiang Empire. 【expression】
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 25 The most powerless despair in troubled times Volume 1 Chapter 26 What bullshit noble people and bullshit rules
